Each direct-create step added a Matter Document type named DOC-030 matters paper <stamp> <role> through the Administrator API and archived it at the end of the step; the gamma template was archived and restored inside its step. scenarios.expected: The Matter has its intended Manager, team, references, and template defaults. Missing required values and unavailable templates produce the supported validation or selection behavior. The dialog draws only the Rows the type's Form collects at creation.
scenarios.actual: 14 recorded browser steps passed for this role (run 1790333890346). Daniel Okafor (Administrator) opened Matters > New matter; Create matter started on the default type "Default" with Matter Manager on the reader, Unassigned first and no Business Users. On "DOC-030 matters type" (Form: Description, Department, Priority, Risk and Needed by On intake form, required note Required for creation, optional note, Entity and person Fields On intake form) the dialog drew Description, Department (No Department), Priority (Medium), Risk (empty choice "Not set"), Needed by and the four Fields, and not Region; Matter template started on No template. "DOC-030 matters retype" (a new type's built-in Rows) drew only Description; "DOC-030 matters department required" drew Department on "Choose a Department", and Create stayed in the dialog with the browser's "Please select an item in the list." until Finance was chosen. Missing values showed "Fill Title, DOC-030 matters required note." then "Fill DOC-030 matters required note."; Cancel created nothing. With a fixture Matter Document type live, staging a PDF showed Document type on "No type"; with the first upload failed by a browser-route stand-in the dialog read "Record created. Some documents could not be uploaded." with Retry failed uploads and Continue, and Retry opened M-85: Status Open, Priority High, Risk Low, Manager Priya Raman, Department Finance, Entity and person references, the Document with the chosen type, and one Key date named Needed by on the picked date. Templates prefilled title, Priority, Risk and Fields with "Template adds 2 tasks and 2 key dates."; switching to beta or No template reset them and kept a typed title. M-86 from the alpha template kept the cleared optional Field empty, got Tasks at +3 days and undated and Key dates at +0 and +7 UTC days, Status Open and no team beyond the creator; its Matter Manager stayed Daniel Okafor, so the Manager-targeted Task went to him. On the retype type the undrawn template Priority High and Risk Low were saved and shown on Overview; a Matter without a template showed Priority Medium and Risk Not assessed. An archived template was refused with "The template must be live and belong to the selected matter type." and left the reopened list. Overview listed Title, Matter type, Description, Department, Priority, Risk, Needed by, Region, the four Fields, then Matter Manager and Business Owner, with no custom-field section; Region EMEA and No Region saved, the Needed by Row moved the Needed by Key date, both owner pickers searched people and showed avatars, and a rename kept M-85. Clearing the required Field was refused; Change matter type to DOC-030 matters retype asked for the required number, Cancel kept the type and Change type saved; switching back kept the value stored and hidden. Naming Jonas Weber Business Owner put him on the Matter team with no remove control; Add team member > Person > Add added Tom Iwu; clearing the Business Owner left Jonas on the team with a remove control. On Confidential M-88, Priya Raman on the team could read and edit but her Add team member was disabled and her team, Confidential flag, Matter Manager and Business Owner changes were refused (403, "Only an Administrator, the matter's creator, or its Matter Manager can change the team on a confidential matter."); the Administrator could change them. Linking an NDA with a Counterparty copied nothing onto the Matter and History listed the changes. The "Confidential — restrict to the matter team" switch saved the flag and Continue opened the Matter without the failed file. Jonas Weber (Business User) had no New matter control, was sent from /matters to /portal and his create was refused (403).

limitations: Independent agent walkthrough by a different agent from the author and technical reviewer; not a human user study and not the feature owner's approval.
Upload and comment failures were browser-route stand-ins (route.abort) for network failures.

The work2 lab is shared with other DOC-030 agents. The magic-link budget (3 per address, 30 per client address in 15 minutes) is shared by all of them; the script waited out 429s and reused one Business User session per run.
The create dialog's empty Risk choice reads "Not set"; Overview reads "Not assessed". The guide names the Overview label for the saved result.

A required Department is enforced by the browser's own required-field check ("Please select an item in the list."), not by an in-dialog alert. The guide's step to fill every visible required Row covers it. Other required built-in Rows were not made required in the lab Forms.
The create flow has no Counterparty control for Matters. The Contract with a Counterparty was linked on Overview (Link Contract), as the guide's last paragraph and matter-work describe.
Development runs left two DOC-030 matters paper Matter Document types live for about ten minutes before they were archived; no other organization setting changed.
